display.title: Episode 183: The Two Brothers on Har HaMoriah (Shiva Asar B'Tammuz)
display.summary_short: Before Shiva Asar B'Tammuz, Uncle Yossi teaches that achdus will rebuild the Beis HaMikdash and tells of two brothers whose secret kindness chose the place where it would stand.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week of Shiva Asar B'Tammuz 5745, which fell on Shabbos and was postponed to Sunday. Uncle Yossi celebrates 182 weeks of Tzivos Hashem on the Air and reminds listeners to send in phone numbers for the Mitzvah Time quiz. He explains that the Hakochainik march is about simcha and achdus, needed most now, since the sad events of the seventeenth of Tammuz came from a lack of unity. After the march and a sponsor message, a girl recites the Shema. He explains the fast, the start of the Three Weeks, and that the Beis HaMikdash, destroyed because of baseless hatred, will be rebuilt through Ahavas Yisroel. Story time: two brother farmers, Reuven with a large family and Shimon with none, each secretly carry sheaves to the other's field at midnight. Climbing the mountain between their fields, they meet at the top and understand. Hashem chose that spot, Har HaMoriah, for the Beis HaMikdash. On Mitzvah Time a listener answers phone questions about how a mezuzah is made, and the show closes with an air-conditioner advertisement.
display.lesson: Baseless hatred destroyed the Beis HaMikdash; love and kindness between Jews will rebuild it.
